You shouldn't have to choose between a fair national price and people who actually know your home. With HES, you get both — the same pricing you'd expect from a national store, with planning, installation, and support from your Greater Seattle neighbors.

      Good questions

      Before you ask.

      Do you need to see my home before quoting a system?

      Yes — that's deliberate. We visit the space before recommending equipment, because room size, light, ceiling height, and existing wiring decide what will actually sound and look right. The visit starts with listening: how you live in the room matters more than a spec sheet.

      Can you add audio or a theater to a home that's already built?

      Most of our work is exactly that. The Leavenworth project above is a retrofit — screen, flush speakers, and porch audio added to an existing timber-and-stone home. Wireless and architectural options mean great sound rarely requires opening walls everywhere.

      Which brands do you install?

      Sonos for wireless speakers; Bowers & Wilkins and Sonance for architectural speakers; Marantz and Denon receivers; Sony and Samsung televisions; Epson projectors; Lutron shades and lighting controls; URC remotes; and eero, Luxul, and Netgear networking. We recommend from that bench based on your room and budget — not the other way around.

      Can one remote really run everything?

      Yes. A properly programmed URC universal remote (or a smart control setup) runs the TV, sound, shades, and lights from one place — and we walk you through it before we leave, so movie night is one button, not four remotes and a prayer.

      Where do you work?

      Greater Seattle is home base, and our project work runs from city neighborhoods to Redmond on the Eastside — and to second homes as far as Leavenworth. If you're not sure you're in range, call and ask.

      Do I pay more for going local instead of a national store?

      No. That's the point of National Pricing, Neighborhood Service. You get pricing in line with what you'd expect nationally on the gear we install, plus the part a national store can't ship you: a local team that visits your home first, installs it carefully, walks you through it, and answers when you call later. Same price thinking, better service — and your dollars support a local, Greater Seattle business.

      What does a project cost?

      It depends on the room, the equipment, and how much of the home is involved — a single media room and a whole-home system are different conversations. The honest answer comes after the in-home visit, when we can recommend the right gear once instead of the wrong gear twice. The conversation itself costs nothing.
